Messages.Author: ReverendRevolver
Messages.Body:
Ok,

So to be clear, the actual having your base 7 cap in play become a 9 cap is why there's the additional drawback, correct?

I understand wanting to boost the founder of a bloodline, but any vamp crossing that 1 pool line from 8 cap to 9 cap immidiately goes into the "3+ turns to get out if my master mix isn't kind to me" club.
It may not seem like it, but it matters quite a bit. I recommend viewing the "submission guidelines" for a template of what to include in submission posts.
I worry that she's currently built just as a nice costume for her base, not as a standalone vamp that is just better when merged (which is what most successful adv vampires are).

Now, as the founder of a bloodline you seem to want to help, I would recommend her helping do something the Anrimanes  can't do.

is decent. Honestly, better than  in many ways, as it has an eagles sight, does stealth about the same (grants it for blood cost) has intercept that seat it somewhere between   and  and has 2 solid rush actions in nose of the hound and charge of the buffalo (which would honestly be better for the  equipped Gangrel, but I've still seen used by ).
It also gets permanent agg hands as an action and the sweetness that is engling fury(basically multiple free beads trifle action). Protean gets s:ce, like 20 ish combat cards with the phrase "this vampires hand strikes are aggravated this round" and of course a hunt that gives votes later and a card that turns you into a dragon for the low low price of like half the blood on the vampire.

I already mentioned she can play bear skin as is, but that's the only good thing I see  doing here, she charges like a buffalo, plays bear skin and crows and punches for 5ish, 2 crows damage..... It's brutal.sort of.

have no way to deal the s:ce. It's one of thier weaknesses. Along with no bounce, and no effective way to prevent damage (they have glancing blow and  outferior on armor of Caine's fury).

Anyway, as an 8 cap she's fair and you don't need the extra pool tax. She's just not good enough for it.
Or you can add interesting stuff to make her worth 9 and relevant, because I'm not seeing a compelling need as is, but I'm sure something can make another  need to exist.

Messages.Body:
First off, why extra discipline. There are no compelling gameplay reasons, neither there are fluff reason.

Another thing, why stacking +1 Strenght ? I understand desire to get another take on Muricia, but there are several other ways to help her (from giving her maneuvrer, press, intercept, some special, looking at enemy hands, cycle, bloat whatever).

Sabbat.Black Hand Shakar: Lech loathe ranged weapons. Once each action, he may burn 1 blood to become Camarilla Prince of Krakow until the end of the action.
